name: Archaeological Monuments Zone of Xochicalco
description: Xochicalco is a hilltop ruined city in Morelos, Mexico, about 38 km southwest of Cuernavaca. It rose to power after Teotihuacan declined, and most of what stands today was built between AD 700 and 900, when perhaps 20,000 people lived here. Its ceremonial centre sits on an artificially levelled summit, ringed by terraces that once held homes, and its observatory can be visited in the afternoon.
